senses.gloss: (an-eñja) adj. immobile, immovable, which leads to rebirth in the arūpāvacara state कर्माणि कुशलाकुशलानेञ्जानि PrasaPa. 334. 8, cf. अनिञ्ज्य.

(an-eñjya) adj. immobile, immovable, which leads to rebirth in the group of gods belonging to the sphere of formless state, i. e. arūpāvacara state संस्काराः। ते च त्रिविधाः कुशला अकुशला आनेज्या (? अनेञ्ज्या)श्च PrasaPa. 543. 2 [DBHS.]
